definitions.explanation: A skin condition characterized by raised, itchy welts that appear suddenly. Caused by allergic reactions, stress, or other triggers.

examples.japanese: {蕁麻疹|じんましん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
⟦{卵|たまご}→卵：02222_tamago⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べたら→食べる：00396_taberu⟧{蕁麻疹|じんましん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: I broke out in hives after eating eggs.

examples.japanese: ⟦ストレス→ストレス：03827_sutoresu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{蕁麻疹|じんましん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧こと⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧らしい。
examples.english: Apparently, hives can also be caused by stress.

notes:
USAGE:
{蕁麻疹|じんましん} is the standard medical and everyday term for hives. The kanji are difficult and rarely written; the word is most often written in hiragana (じんましん) or katakana (ジンマシン) in everyday contexts.

COMMON PATTERNS:
The most common verb pattern is {蕁麻疹|じんましん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧ (hives appear/break out). Note that Japanese uses ⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧ (to come out) rather than a verb meaning "to get."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {蕁麻疹|じんましん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧ (to break out in hives)
- {蕁麻疹|じんましん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧ (for hives to subside)
- {蕁麻疹|じんましん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{治|おさ}まる→治まる：27790_osamaru⟧ (for hives to clear up)
